# meshoptimizer 0.25

Unmodified `src/meshoptimizer.h`, `src/simplifier.cpp`, `src/allocator.cpp` and
`LICENSE.md` from <https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/tree/v0.25>.
Only the CPU simplifier is compiled, through `../../block_lod.cpp`.
MIT-licensed dependency; TerraForest's own code retains its existing 0BSD terms.
The export tool ships `addons/structures/MESHOPTIMIZER_LICENSE.txt` alongside
the native library. No network access or third-party DLL is needed at runtime.
